sources.title: USTC September 7 visit to the Gaoxin campus data-centre room
sources.publisher: 中国科学技术大学网络信息中心 (USTC Network Information Center)
sources.source_family: 中国科学技术大学网络信息中心 (USTC Network Information Center)
sources.attribution: 中国科学技术大学网络信息中心 (USTC Network Information Center)
sources.summary: USTC reports that its executive vice-president visited the Gaoxin campus data-centre room on September 7. The visit examined its infrastructure, core campus-network equipment and server operations, alongside discussion of computing resources and university services.
sources.original_title: 校党委常委、常务副校长傅尧调研学校网络信息化和算力基础设施建设
sources.date_semantics: The September 9 publication explicitly dates the physical visit to September 7. This supports existing operations on September 7; it is not an opening or completion date.
sources.scope_limit: The separate subsequent visit to the Smart Campus Joint Innovation Center is not used as evidence of a demonstration-only machine room. No campus-wide HPC/AI capacity is assigned to this room.

sources.title: USTC Gaoxin data-centre equipment hosting management
sources.publisher: 中国科学技术大学网络信息中心 (USTC Network Information Center)
sources.source_family: 中国科学技术大学网络信息中心 (USTC Network Information Center)
sources.attribution: 中国科学技术大学网络信息中心 (USTC Network Information Center)
sources.summary: The university provides a room-management system for research groups hosting equipment in the Gaoxin campus data-centre room. It supports equipment monitoring, repair requests and hosting-resource reservations.
sources.original_title: 中国科学技术大学机房管理系统上线试运行通知
sources.date_semantics: Historical operator context only. Trial operation describes management software, not a demonstration-only data-centre facility.

sources.original_title: 中国科学技术大学2023级研究生新生入学常见问题解答

sources.title: USTC Gaoxin campus, native OpenStreetMap relation 14093671
sources.summary: The native named multipolygon represents USTC Gaoxin campus in Hefei. A point inside its southern component identifies the broader parent campus. It does not identify the data-centre building or room.
sources.date_semantics: Map metadata and capture dates are not facility status dates.

sources.title: Native OpenStreetMap context for Gaoxin campus and boundary roads
sources.summary: The native map includes the named Gaoxin campus and Fuxing Road south of its southern component, with Shilian South Road along the west. These roads correspond to the university entrance directions.
sources.date_semantics: Named map context only. No surveyed cadastral extent or independent imagery check claimed.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap Gaoxin campus edit provenance, changeset 177215665
sources.summary: The January 2026 contributor describes improvements to USTC Gaoxin campus information, lists local knowledge and Bing aerial imagery, and requests review. These contributor tags do not establish measured positional accuracy.
sources.date_semantics: Mapping provenance, not a data-centre observation.

sources.title: Science Tokyo reports completed TSUBAME4 compute-node maintenance on September 7
sources.summary: The TSUBAME4 operator completed emergency compute-node maintenance at about 18:40 on September 7, 2026. The work involved running jobs and successive compute-node restarts.

status_observation_review.basis: Dated original operator notice describes running jobs and completed compute-node maintenance on the same day. Operational lifecycle status with temporary interruption; no new facility opening inferred.

sources.title: Science Tokyo timestamps TSUBAME4 service availability on September 29
sources.summary: The operator reported TSUBAME4 available at 10:00 on September 29, 2026, followed by login nodes, batch queues, storage and application services at 11:00. A separate 11:20 notice reported a problem with application-distribution requests.
sources.date_semantics: Explicit September 29 timestamp on the operator’s service-status statement. The publication day of the containing homepage is unknown and remains null. This is a later achieved availability observation, not a scheduled event or retrieval date.
sources.integration_note: Selected operational observation is the explicit September 29 status entry. The validated explicit-observation path retains a null publication day for the containing homepage; neither retrieval nor an older notice replaces the observed day.

sources.title: Operator guidance identifies the converted G4-A data-center building
sources.summary: The April 2024 TSUBAME4 guide identifies G4-A as the converted data-center building. Its layout shows a 210 m² machine room, separate electrical rooms and outdoor cooling equipment. The room area describes the 2024 layout; it is not the total building area.

sources.title: Operator identifies Yokohama as the current TSUBAME4 host campus
sources.summary: TSUBAME4 visitor information places the facility at Yokohama campus, formerly called Suzukakedai.

sources.title: University campus map names G4-A building 34
sources.summary: Science Tokyo’s Yokohama campus map identifies G4-A as building 34, separate from G4, building 33.

sources.title: Suzukakedai campus was renamed Yokohama in April 2026
sources.summary: Suzukakedai was renamed Yokohama Campus on April 1, 2026.

sources.title: Google Maps selected named Yokohama university campus point
sources.summary: The selected Google Maps feature names the Yokohama university campus at 4259 Nagatsutacho and links the official university website. Its original response contains the named-feature coordinate tuple. The point is used solely as a wider host-campus locator for the known G4-A data center, not as a building position.

sources.title: University reports the2024 launch and academic/commercial research use of TSUBAME4
sources.summary: The university’s June 2024 launch report describes TSUBAME4 operating at Suzukakedai for university, external academic and corporate researchers. G4-A was among the launch-visit venues.
